description: A reviewer's whole output for one review of one change. Every field is required; a field that does not apply is null or an empty array.

verdict.description: approve: nothing should hold this. request_changes: at least one open finding blocks. needs_decision: no open blocker, and a person must decide something. undetermined: you could not establish whether the change is correct.

headline.description: One sentence a maintainer reads first. For request_changes, the most important finding. For needs_decision, the question. For undetermined, what stopped you. For approve, an empty string.

basis.description: Exactly five rows, one per question, each established against the head under review.

detail.description: One line: what was run or read, and what it showed.

not_checked.description: What bears on the change and was not checked, one short line each.

spidey_sense.description: What does not sit right, and important questions you could not answer, one short line each. No proof is needed and no verdict depends on it. Usually empty.

findings.description: Every finding of this review and every finding of an earlier review of the same change, each with its state now.

id.description: A short kebab-case name. An earlier finding keeps the id its thread carries.

blocks.description: true: the author must act before merge. false: an observation nothing waits on.

asked.description: The one question this finding fails.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the changed file the finding is anchored to, or null when no changed line fits.

start_line.description: First line of a range in the file at the head, or null for a single line.

line.description: The line, or the last line of the range, in the file at the head. It must be a line the diff shows.

point.description: The finding in one sentence. A reader may stop here.

body.description: Markdown: why it matters, with the code it is about when that code is not at the anchored lines.

suggestion.description: The exact replacement for the anchored lines when that replacement is the whole fix; otherwise null.

proof.description: Markdown: what was run and what it showed, enough to reproduce the finding. A test goes in as a patch the author can apply.

rests_on.description: URIs of the concepts or documents the finding rests on, such as concept:///rule/agent-experience/ActionableErrors.md.

reply.description: Markdown to say in the finding's thread this time: how a fix was confirmed, why it is withdrawn, or an answer to the author's reply. Null when there is nothing new to say.

decisions.description: What only a person can settle. One question each.

question.description: One question a person can answer in a word or a sentence.

context.description: Markdown: a few sentences on what depends on the answer.

answer.description: When answered: what the person decided, in a few words. Otherwise null.

reply.description: Markdown to say in the decision's thread this time: what the answer leads to, or the question asked again more narrowly when a reply did not answer it. Null when there is nothing new to say.

lessons.description: Rules this review surfaced that the team will want again, proposed as concepts for the author to capture.

relevance.description: URI globs naming where the rule applies.

from.description: The id of the finding or decision it came from.
